name: Thadius Grimshade
summary: At Nethergarde Keep, Talonaxe sends you to Thadius Grimshade with a feather from Sharpbeak's nest.

sections.title: A Plea to a Diviner
sections.body: Years ago, Thadius Grimshade left Aerie Peak to seek darker knowledge. Yet Talonaxe says he remains a Wildhammer at heart. He hopes Thadius can use divining magic and Sharpbeak's feather to find the gryphon child. Thadius lives in the mage tower at Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands.

sections.title: The Diviner's Welcome
sections.body: Thadius Grimshade welcomes you as someone bearing a gift. He recognizes the feather as belonging to a fine gryphon, one meant for great things if he grows up unharmed. Then Thadius asks you to listen closely.

faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade left Aerie Peak years ago to seek darker knowledge. Talonaxe says he remains a Wildhammer at heart.

faq.q: Why do you need Sharpbeak's feather?
faq.answer: Sharpbeak's feather came from the nest where he sleeps. Talonaxe hopes Thadius can use divining magic on it to find the young gryphon.
Thadius Grimshade lives in the mage tower at Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands.
